name: send21
description: Crypto pay links and API for people and AI agents. Tools for creating drafts, payment requests, transaction templates, rates, and fees. Agents onboard themselves; humans approve where the money lands. send21 never holds keys or funds.

authentication.description: Authorization: Bearer s21_<api key>. Scoped API keys at https://send21.io/api-keys. tools/list works unauthenticated.
